verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions AI-training data use, opt-outs, or a no-training policy. Indirect protection comes only from deployment options: on-prem or own-infrastructure deployment of Orama Cloud, a free open-source library that runs in your own app, and Orama Cloud generating embeddings with local models rather than sending data out. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment or opt-out control for Orama Cloud, documented data-usage terms covering third-party LLM calls such as the OpenAI-proxied AnswerSession, and independent corroboration.
